_note: jjiroo-tancheon-duck-chase-002 storyboard-first rerun plan. Reuse the original 001 drawing style basis, stay reference-only, and lock cast cardinality before image generation.

format.timingNote: Narration exists upstream, so storyboard pacing should remain compatible with a later local/basic no-paid-API timing pass before final durations lock.

mustPreserve: Keep the same original 001 pet-webtoon illustration style.
Keep Tancheon path, grass edge, shallow river, duck rest area, and climb-out bank readable as one continuous location.
Keep Jjiroo as the visual protagonist even when mother enters the frame.
Keep Jjiroo mint Y-harness and Jjonga peach harness stable in every cut where they appear.

cuts.beat: Sunny Tancheon walk establishes mother, Jjiroo, and Jjonga moving together along the riverside path.
cuts.cameraConcept: Vertical medium-wide establishing shot showing dirt path, grass edge, and river in one readable composition.
cuts.motionPotential: Light walking loop, leash sway, grass breeze, easy opening push.
cuts.continuityGoal: Introduce the full walk geography and lock both harness colors before action starts.
cuts.promptCore: Show one cream-ivory Jjiroo in a mint Y-harness and one caramel-brown Jjonga in a peach harness walking with their mother on a bright Tancheon riverside path.

cuts.beat: The two dogs enjoy the walk by sniffing dirt, grass, and the environment before the incident begins.
cuts.cameraConcept: Lower angle slice-of-life frame focused on dog behavior with the mother partly present above or behind them.
cuts.motionPotential: Sniffing noses, tail flicks, tiny steps, path-life detail.
cuts.continuityGoal: Reinforce that Jjiroo and Jjonga are separate dogs with different silhouettes and energy.
cuts.promptCore: Show one Jjiroo and one Jjonga enjoying the walk, sniffing around the Tancheon path while the mother remains a secondary guardian presence.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo spots ducks resting near the riverbank and locks onto them with sudden focused curiosity.
cuts.cameraConcept: Reaction composition foregrounding Jjiroo while ducks remain readable in the distance near the bank.
cuts.motionPotential: Ear perk, gaze snap, subtle push toward ducks.
cuts.continuityGoal: Keep the ducks visibly outside the water at first and make Jjiroo's attention shift readable.
cuts.promptCore: Show one Jjiroo suddenly freezing and staring toward three resting ducks near the riverside bank while Jjonga remains nearby as a calmer observer.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo lowers into a stalking posture and edges forward while the ducks are still momentarily unaware.
cuts.cameraConcept: Low side-profile tension frame with crouched body language and readable riverbank depth.
cuts.motionPotential: Tiny paw placement, body compression, harness tension, held suspense.
cuts.continuityGoal: Keep this as curiosity-driven stalking, not predator violence, and preserve the same bank geography.
cuts.promptCore: Show one Jjiroo in a low curious stalking pose near the bank, focused on three ducks that have not fully reacted yet.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo snaps free and rockets toward the ducks as they burst away toward the river.
cuts.cameraConcept: Dynamic diagonal chase composition with ducks breaking toward water and the chase direction clearly readable.
cuts.motionPotential: Sprint burst, duck flutter, directional smear, fast escalation.
cuts.continuityGoal: Sell the breakaway moment without creating duplicate Jjiroo bodies or violent contact with ducks.
cuts.promptCore: Show one Jjiroo exploding into a sprint toward three ducks that are escaping toward the river, with the mother reacting behind him.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo commits to the chase and dives into the shallow river after the ducks.
cuts.cameraConcept: Impact frame at the water-entry point showing the exact bank Jjiroo launched from.
cuts.motionPotential: Launch, splash burst, water entry transition, startled shoreline reaction.
cuts.continuityGoal: Make Jjiroo the first one in the river and keep Jjonga safely on shore as a witness.
cuts.promptCore: Show one Jjiroo diving into the shallow river after three escaping ducks while one Jjonga stays back on shore.

cuts.beat: The mother jumps into the river after Jjiroo, who is already swimming ahead.
cuts.cameraConcept: Layered depth shot with soaked mother behind, Jjiroo midstream, and ducks farther ahead.
cuts.emotion: Alarmed rescue energy with comic mismatch.
cuts.motionPotential: Water churn, arm reach, strong swim direction, widening distance gag.
cuts.continuityGoal: Mother enters after Jjiroo, not with him, and Jjiroo must still read as confident rather than distressed.
cuts.promptCore: Show one mother jumping into the river in pursuit while one Jjiroo is already swimming ahead of her and three ducks remain farther forward.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo moves fast through the current while the mother struggles behind, creating a brief lost-him scare.
cuts.cameraConcept: Long vertical river-lane frame emphasizing distance between Jjiroo and the mother.
cuts.motionPotential: Upstream swim rhythm, ripples, effort contrast, fleeing ducks out of reach.
cuts.continuityGoal: Keep the danger level comic and readable, not panic-driven, while selling Jjiroo's surprising swim speed.
cuts.promptCore: Show one Jjiroo confidently swimming ahead in the river with the mother trailing behind and two ducks still escaping farther away.

cuts.beat: Jjiroo gives up on the ducks, returns to shore, and climbs out on his own.
cuts.cameraConcept: Recovery shot focused on the same climb-out bank so the self-rescue reads clearly.
cuts.motionPotential: Wet dog climb, shake-off setup, mother still recovering behind.
cuts.continuityGoal: Make the self-recovery unambiguous: Jjiroo is already solving the problem himself before the payoff lands.
cuts.promptCore: Show one dripping Jjiroo climbing out of the river onto the readable bank by himself while the mother remains wet behind him.

cuts.beat: Final payoff: Jjiroo stands safely on shore and gives the soaked mother a puzzled, innocent look.
cuts.cameraConcept: Comedy reaction frame with Jjiroo foreground on land and the mother stranded behind in the water or at the edge.
cuts.motionPotential: Tiny hold, blink, head tilt, lingering reaction beat.
cuts.continuityGoal: Land the joke that only the mother ended up soaked while Jjiroo looks almost confused by her situation.
cuts.promptCore: Show one safe Jjiroo back on shore giving the soaked mother a puzzled 'why are you in there' look, with no visible danger left in frame.
